title: Understanding Missing Data
text: When dealing with missing data, it's important to consider how the missing values might affect your analysis. Think about whether the missing dates are random or if there's a pattern.

title: Options for Handling Missing Data
text: Consider the different methods for handling missing data: dropping rows, imputing values, or using interpolation. Each method has its pros and cons depending on the context.

hintAnswer: Interpolation can estimate missing values based on surrounding data points, maintaining the chronological order.
